headline: AI Data Center Projects Drive Up US Warehouse Demand and Rents
summary: According to JLL, artificial intelligence data center projects have boosted US warehouse demand, pushing average asking rents up 3.2% year-over-year to $10.55 per square foot.
why: JLL is a global commercial real estate services firm, tracking sector-wide rental and demand metrics.

impacts.name: Commercial Real Estate
impacts.why: Increased demand for specialized facilities supports higher rental rates for industrial landlords.
